co-01-kiros.text: Supports an arms embargo and ending military aid to Israel.

ny-13-avila-chevalier.text: Supports Medicare for All, including dental, vision, hearing and long-term care.
Calls for fully funding Section 8 and NYCHA and building affordable housing.
Calls for raising the minimum wage and increasing union density.
Calls for abolishing ICE, expanding paths to citizenship and free legal representation for immigrants.

mi-sen-el-sayed.text: Calls for banning corporate money in politics.

mi-07-lawrence.text: Calls for the U.S. to stop arming Israel and calls the war in Gaza a genocide.
Calls for federal investment to curb climate change and lower energy bills.
Supports major federal housing investment, a federal tenant bill of rights and Housing First.
Calls for ending ICE operations in American cities and a path to citizenship.

ny-07-valdez.text: Supports Medicare for All, including gender-affirming care, contraception and PrEP.
Calls for ending all weapons sales and military aid to Israel.
Calls for tenant power and landlord accountability.
Supports a strengthened PRO Act and ending at-will employment.

oh-07-poindexter.text: Pledges to protect Medicare and Social Security.
Backs workers' freedom to organize without intimidation.

pa-03-rabb.text: Calls for an immediate, permanent ceasefire and says the genocide in Gaza must end.
Calls for a Civilian Climate Corps and a transition to renewable energy.

tx-23-padilla-stout.text: Supports expanding Medicare to all Americans and, short of that, strengthening the ACA.
Says the U.S. must act on climate change based on science.
Calls for bipartisan reform that secures the border with humane immigration laws.

ny-12-lasher.text: Calls for expanding housing tax credits and rental assistance.
Pledges to cosponsor the PRO Act and to index the minimum wage to inflation.
Calls for aggressive oversight hearings on ICE abuses.

nj-12-hamawy.text: Supports single-payer Medicare for All with no out-of-pocket costs.
Supports cutting off military aid to Israel and equal rights for Palestinians.
Calls for rejoining international climate agreements.
Calls for abolishing ICE, dismantling DHS and a path to citizenship.

ny-17-conley.text: Defends the ACA and Medicaid and would expand Medicare to cover vision, dental and hearing.
Calls for rejoining the Paris Agreement.
Calls for easing zoning rules and more federal funding for affordable housing.
Calls for comprehensive reform, with enforcement focused on violent criminals.

mn-02-little.text: Calls for an end to violence and genocide in Israel and Palestine.
Calls for getting ICE out of Minnesota.
Rejects AIPAC, super PAC and corporate PAC money and supports ending Citizens United.

mi-13-mckinney.text: Pledges to cosponsor the Block the Bombs Act and end military aid to Israel.
Supports a Green New Deal and 100% clean energy.
Supports a national homes guarantee, new public housing and nationwide rent control.
Supports every worker's right to form a union and a living wage.
Calls for a path to citizenship for all immigrants and closing for-profit detention centers.
Supports banning political donations from monopoly utilities and government contractors.

ca-07-vang.text: Supports a federal renters' bill of rights and limits on corporate purchases of homes.
Supports the PRO Act and a minimum wage tied to inflation.
Calls for defunding mass deportation and ending qualified immunity for ICE agents.

ca-34-gonzales-torres.text: Pledges to cosponsor Medicare for All.
Calls for an arms embargo and a ceasefire in Gaza.
Supports a Green New Deal and a climate emergency declaration.
Supports guaranteed housing vouchers, community land trusts and permanently affordable housing.
Supports the right to unionize for gig workers.
Calls for abolishing ICE and a path to citizenship.
Refuses corporate PAC and super PAC money and supports overturning Citizens United.

mt-01-forstag.text: Would let everyone join Medicare, free for working people.
Calls for large-scale federal investment in affordable housing and zoning reform.
Calls for more union jobs in construction and the trades.

me-sen-jackson.text: Supports Medicare for All and would cosponsor it in the Senate.
Calls the war in Gaza a genocide and would stop U.S. funding for Israel's military.
Backs the right to organize a union without retaliation.
Rejects corporate PAC, AIPAC and Big Oil money and supports overturning Citizens United.

ca-22-villegas.text: Supports Medicare for All, including dental and vision.
Calls for holding corporate polluters accountable and protecting farmworkers from extreme heat.
Calls for an ambitious federal program to build affordable housing.
Supports ending Citizens United, banning corporate PACs and banning stock trading by members of Congress.

tx-sen-talarico.text: Calls health care a human right and pledges to protect Medicaid and lower drug costs.
Supports stopping offensive weapons sales to the Netanyahu government while funding defensive systems like Iron Dome.
Backs an all-of-the-above energy strategy, including oil and gas, with more climate disaster preparedness.
Supports the PRO Act and a $15 federal minimum wage.
Calls for comprehensive reform, more Border Patrol agents and focusing ICE on cartels and gangs.
Has never taken corporate PAC money and supports banning super PACs and corporate PACs.

ny-10-lander.text: Pledges to champion Medicare for All.
Pledges to cosponsor the Block the Bombs Act and calls Israel's destruction of Gaza a genocide.
Supports a Green New Deal and ending reliance on fossil fuels.
Proposes federal "Street-to-Home" housing vouchers and national standards for investor-owned rental housing.
Supports workers' right to organize and protections for gig workers.
Has called for abolishing ICE since 2018.
Rejects corporate PAC and AIPAC money and supports overturning Citizens United and a stock trading ban.

dc-al-white.text: Calls for securing federal resources for affordable housing in D.C.
Pledges to protect Washingtonians from ICE.

tx-30-haynes.text: Calls for expanding access to affordable housing, childcare, health care and paid family leave.
Calls for closing loopholes that let corporate interests hide spending through super PACs and nonprofits.
